primitive_input.composition: e_next o e admitted iff target(e) = source(e_next)
primitive_input.metric_clock: introduced only downstream through reference calibration

derived_coordinates.occurrence: nu_k = (P_k, x_k) with full realized prefix P_k
derived_coordinates.prefix_order: nu_i <= nu_j iff P_j = Q o P_i
derived_coordinates.temporal_precedence: nu_i <_T nu_j iff nu_i is a strict prefix occurrence of nu_j
derived_coordinates.now_frontier: N(D) = Max_{<_T}({supported realized occurrences in D})

gremlin.contract: relation composition -> prefix extension; prefix extension -> occurrence order; positive extensive measure -> scalar order embedding; maximal supported occurrences -> NOW frontier
